title: THIRD LEVEL SPELLS - the 20 third level shukenja spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and sohei codes
audit_label: R661 OA third level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round forty-eight (capture pp. 126-132): the third level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and sohei-usable markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: THIRD LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 126-132 - the OA third level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read - the 20 third level spell stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes (print pp. 126-132; compressed pp. 63-66); all 20 schools, component sets, casting times and saving throws agree, zero contested stat reads. Two school codes debut this level: invocation (dream vision) and illusion/phantasm (invisibility to spirits) - both headers read identically in the two passes. Abjuration becomes the most common school at seven spells (castigate, cure blindness, cure disease, dispel magic, oath, remove curse, remove paralysis); magical vestment's dual school conjuration/alteration pins as the primary conjuration, the aid convention from the second level. Substitution takes the longest cast in the level at three turns. The reversible flags agree between the passes; the sohei-usable marks ride the R658 T62 grid, settled three rounds before. The stat grid pins as a table: 20 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60, 3 turns = 180), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special), reversible and sohei markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions and the Table 64 speak with dead grid close in their own rounds. The table tag L3Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
